findings.summary: _backup_beside returns silently when prismis.db.bak-tz already exists, so the backup is not rewritten. If an earlier attempt failed (rolled back, backup left behind), the operator repairs data and restarts, the migration then rewrites the database against a stale backup that no longer holds the pre-migration state. The skip is also not recorded anywhere. No test covers a pre-existing backup file. The migration tests only cover absent-backup and second-run cases. The second-run test deletes the backup before re-running. Breaks the stake that a rewriting migration first writes a VACUUM INTO backup of the pre-migration database.
